grounded-01.summary: Exact proposed normalization collapses finite binary-mask features and yields NaNs on constant columns. This is an operator diagnostic, not a predictive benchmark.

grounded-02.summary: Shared weights are covered by NeuMiss 2021. In a supplementary inverse-operator diagnostic, standard Richardson and Chebyshev controls outperform the scalar-coefficient candidate at matched polynomial degree. No trained-network or novelty claim.

grounded-03.summary: The literal iteration converges to the wrong inverse operator even after global rescaling. Corrected Jacobi is equivalent to standardization in this diagnostic. No predictive or novelty claim.

grounded-interface-v2.summary: At identical resident precision counts, 1-bit mean-logit ranking had higher local attention-output error than exact prompt-attention mass on both exposed SmolVLM images (0.02518 vs 0.01510; 0.02229 vs 0.01510). Fixed-budget development gate failed. Generic visual-token chunk surrogate, not a WindowQuant/FIER replication. No end-to-end quality, speed or novelty claim.

grounded-contract-v1.summary: One-bit max lowers relative L2 slightly on two exposed images but remains worse than exact attention mass; cosine worsens slightly on candy. Original controls reproduce exactly. This is local teacher-forced replay, not an end-to-end task or speed result.
